quantity: Mass without battery
notes: AC-06 in evidence/v995-fixture-measurements holds the flight-ready mass; do not re-enter it here. DR-01 plus DR-02 must reproduce AC-06 within the scale resolution.

quantity: Battery mass
Mass of one propeller
feeds: CAD prop part; blade inertia for the rotor model
notes: Only if a prop can be removed without damage. Leave blank otherwise.

quantity: Mass of one guard
notes: Only if removable. Leave blank otherwise.

quantity: Motor shaft to motor shaft diagonal
notes: Shaft centre to shaft centre. Deters 2018 Table 1 uses this as aircraft size (Cheerson CX-10 45 mm, Crazyflie 127 mm).

quantity: Overall length / width / height with guards
notes: Three values per reading, separated by slashes. Height from the standing surface to the highest point.

quantity: Arm length from body edge to pod centre
notes: Record which body edge is the datum.

quantity: Arm section width and thickness at the root
notes: Two values per reading. The root section sets the first bending mode more than any other dimension.

quantity: Arm section width and thickness at the pod
Propeller diameter tip to tip
notes: Replaces the declared 31 to 40 mm range. Measure across opposite blade tips; for three blades, measure tip to hub centre and double it, and say so.

quantity: Blade count / hub diameter / hub height
Blade chord at 75 percent radius
method: photo with scale bar or calipers
notes: Deters 2018 reports Re at the 75 percent station. A photo against millimetre paper is enough; record the pixel scale.

quantity: Blade pitch angle at 75 percent radius
method: photo of the blade silhouette edge-on against a protractor
notes: Hard to read on a 35 mm prop; a blank is better than a guess. Blade thickness at the same station if measurable.

quantity: Motor can diameter and length
column15: Do not pull a glued motor. If only the diameter is visible, record that and leave the length blank.

quantity: Pod outer diameter and height
Guard ring outer diameter / ring section width and thickness
Strut count and strut section
Shell wall thickness at an open edge
feeds: shell part; modal and impact models
notes: Measure at a battery-bay or canopy edge; do not cut the shell.

quantity: Material marking
feeds: material family for E and density ranges
notes: A recycling code identifies the family only; take E and density as datasheet ranges for that family and let the tap test fit E.

quantity: PCB envelope length / width / thickness and mounting
notes: Envelope only. No probing of pads (OQ-011 is closed).

quantity: Battery length / width / thickness and label text
Top / bottom / side / each part with a scale bar
notes: Record file names here. Every CAD feature should be traceable to a photo or a row above.
